plainName: Who counts as the owner of a house
summary: You are treated as the owner of a house you transferred without adequate consideration to your spouse, other than to live apart, or to a minor child other than a married daughter; of an impartible estate you hold; of a building allotted or leased to you by a co-operative society, company or association under a house-building scheme; of a building you hold in part performance of a contract of sale; and of a building you hold on a long lease. You enter such a house as your own.

routes.name: A house you are treated as owning
routes.description: Entered and computed as a house you own.
